Which skeleton is made depends on how the '''Gravestone''' was made. }} ==Description== The '''Gravestone''' was an enemy that appeared in [[Blind Faith]] as part of the [[Null & Void Event]]. It is an immobile [[Aggro]] enemy, meaning that it cannot kill the player directly though it can distract towers from targeting it. When destroyed, it will create a skeleton, with the skeleton created depending on how the '''Gravestone''' was made. If summoned by the [[Null Necromancer]], it can spawn the [[Giant Skeleton]], [[Hallow Guard (Null & Void)|Hallow Guard]] and [[Executioner Skeleton (Null & Void)|Executioner Skeleton]]. If summoned by the player in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, it will always spawn a [[Hallow Guard (Null & Void)|Hallow Guard]]. ==Logbook Description== "''The Gravestone was carefully created by Grave Digger. After his mutation, he spent days carving thousands of these stone heads. The Necromancers discovered how to enchant them, binding their magic to each stone so that the dead would rise wherever one is placed.''" ==Mutation== Assumes that [[Mutation]] is activated and a '''Gravestone''' is created on the earliest wave possible of the Hard difficulty. {| class="tds-table align-center mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" style="width: 300px; margin: 0 auto" ! colspan="2" |Mutation |- !Percentage !Increase |- |2.5% |10.1 |- !Wave !Health |- |28 |3,414 |- |29 |3,424 |- |30 |3,434 |} ==Appearance== The '''Gravestone''' is a dark grey gravestone with a crack in it and a black skull on top. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Blind Faith]] is listed instead. *The '''Gravestone''' itself is not a threat as it cannot kill the player directly, though it can lead to other enemies getting past your towers. *Defense dropping towers can be used to reduce its high defense of 130%. **As it has the [[Freeze Immunity]], freezing towers cannot be used for this. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseGravestone.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (31 October 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} GravestoneIconIG.png|'''Gravestone''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *Prior to the [[v2.3.0]], the '''Gravestone''' had the highest [[Defense]] of all enemies in the game, at 130%. This would end up being overtaken by the [[Vindicator]], with a ludicrous 150% base [[Defense]]. *The '''Gravestone''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''31 October 2025''' - [[v1.79.0]] **'''Gravestone''' added. *'''26 November 2025''' - [[v1.80.0|v1.80.1e]] **'''Gravestone''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''3 December 2025''' - [[v1.82.0]] **{{Bug}} Cannot be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''4 December 2025''' - [[v1.82.0]]b ** {{Bugfix}} Can now be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Null & Void Event]] [[Category:Blind Faith]]
